title: The tech job market in the AI era
description:
- Which tech roles are changing because of AI
- New roles emerging around AI
- What skills will matter most for junior developers
- How AI is changing the expectations for engineers
- AI-assisted coding: what companies expect candidates to know
- How to stay competitive without trying to become an AI expert overnight
abstract: AI is changing the tech job market, from the roles companies hire for to the skills they expect from candidates. Explore the emerging opportunities, how AI-assisted development is changing engineering careers, and what junior developers can do today to stay competitive in an increasingly AI-driven industry.
